channel.title: East Coast Weekends — New York City guides
channel.description: East Coast Weekends is an independent guide to the best two- and three-day trips within reach of New York: the Hudson Valley, Philadelphia, Boston, Washington and Niagara Falls, with train times, costs and honest itineraries.
